Job Description: Business Intelligence Engineer – Data Engineering 
 
Helmerich & Payne | https://www.hpinc.com/ 
 
India Office Address: 
- 
Office 201, 2nd Floor, Unit 1, Adwalpalkar Horizon, Oitalem, Taleigao, Goa 403004 
 
- 
Unit 506, 5th floor, World Trade Tower, Central Auto Market, Block B, Sector 16, Noida, 
Uttar Pradesh 201301 
 
 
MS Azure, Databricks, PySpark, SparkSQL, ADF, ADLS 
 
 
Job Overview 
We are looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer (Data Engineering) to join our Advanced Analytics 
and Reporting team. This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about data engineering, business 
operations, and transforming complex data into actionable insights. The ideal candidate will work 
closely with stakeholders as a solution partner, independently managing end-to-end data engineering 
projects including designing, developing, optimizing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and 
notebooks within Azure environments. The role also requires ensuring data reliability, accuracy, and 
efficient data flow across systems. In addition to data engineering responsibilities, the candidate 
should be capable of analyzing data, identifying trends and insights, and developing intuitive 
dashboards and visualizations when required. This position involves regular collaboration with 
international teams and requires strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder 
management skills. This is a hybrid role (at manager’s discretion) within the Business Intelligence and 
Performance Management (BIPM) team. 
 
Responsibilities for BI Engineer (Data Engineering) 
- 
Partner with stakeholders to understand business operations, KPIs, and Business Intelligence 
requirements 
- 
Translate business requirements into well-defined Jira epics, user stories, and acceptance 
criteria 
- 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Microsoft Azure, Databricks, 
ADF, and ADLS 
- 
Develop efficient and optimized Databricks notebooks using PySpark and SparkSQL for data 
transformation and analytics 
- 
Implement business logic and transformation requirements into reliable and maintainable 
data engineering solutions 
- 
Monitor and optimize pipelines for performance, stability, scalability, and cost efficiency 
- 
Ensure continuous and reliable data flow across enterprise systems and reporting platforms 
- 
Collaborate with IT teams and source system owners to resolve data quality, refresh, and 
integration issues 
- 
Work closely with senior developers and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality BI 
and data engineering solutions 
- 
Maintain clear technical, functional, and process documentation for all deliverables 
- 
Support CI/CD implementation and deployment best practices within the data engineering 
lifecycle 
- 
Continuously explore and adopt emerging technologies in Microsoft Azure, Databricks and AI 
 
Technical Skills 
Must Have 
- 
Strong experience with Databricks Notebooks using PySpark and SparkSQL for data 
transformation and advanced analytics 
- 
Hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines using Azure Data Factory 
(ADF), Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), and Databricks 
- 
Strong expertise in Databricks Job orchestration, cluster configuration, performance 
tuning, and cost monitoring 
- 
Strong understanding of notebook optimization techniques using PySpark and SparkSQL 
- 
Proficiency with version control tools such as GitHub 
- 
Solid understanding of data engineering concepts including ETL/ELT frameworks and 
Medallion Architecture 
- 
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills 
- 
Experience with CI/CD processes and deployment practices in data engineering 
environments 
- 
Ability to work independently and effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced 
environment 
Good to Have 
- 
Experience with Microsoft Fabric ecosystem 
- 
Knowledge of BI and visualization tools such as Power BI (DAX, Power Query) 
- 
Exposure to Agentic AI concepts, automation workflows, or AI-enabled analytics 
solutions 
- 
Experience collaborating with cross-functional and international teams 
- 
Experience with Power Automate 
- 
Domain experience in Oil & Gas or similar data-intensive industries 
 
Qualifications 
- 
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in petroleum engineering, mechanical engineering, computer 
science, analytics, or other quantitative disciplines 
- 
Experience or exposure to operational domains such as Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, 
Maintenance, or related industries is preferred 
 
 
Preferred Attributes 
- 
Curious and business-oriented mindset with a strong interest in understanding operational 
processes 
- 
Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and commitment to delivering results 
- 
Proactive problem solver with strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities 
- 
Ability to translate complex data into meaningful business insights and actionable 
recommendations 
- 
Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, collaborative, and globally connected 
environment 
- 
Strong documentation, organizational, and multitasking skills 
- 
Excellent professional, interpersonal, and communication skills 
- 
Flexible, adaptable, and team-oriented approach to work 
- 
Ethical, self-motivated individual with the ability to set priorities and achieve goals 
effectively 
- 
Demonstrates a workplace culture that is committed to the H&P Way 
o Actively C.A.R.E 
o Service Attitude 
o Innovative Spirit 
o Teamwork 
o Do the Right Thing
